In this notebook we preform PERMANOVA on KrakenUniq read profiles against clinical metadata. 
This analysis will be used to survey microbial profile associations with a broad range of disease relavent metadata including anthropomorphic, behavioral, and medication usage covariates. The analysis will be parallelized using the `batchtools` package and the `slurm` job scheduler for efficient computation.


```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

pdmbs_dir <- "/resnick/groups/MazmanianLab/jboktor/PDMBS"
wgs_wkdir <- paste0(pdmbs_dir, "/workflow/WGS")
wkdir <- paste0(pdmbs_dir, "/pdairr")
source(paste0(wkdir, "/notebooks/R_scripts/_load-core-pkgs.R"))
source(paste0(wkdir, "/notebooks/R_scripts/_misc_functions.R"))
source(paste0(wkdir, "/notebooks/R_scripts/_plot-functions.R"))
source(paste0(wkdir, "/notebooks/R_scripts/_analysis_funcs.R"))
library(phyloseq)
library(microbiome)
library(plotly)
library(ggsci)

permanova_results_dir <- glue("{wkdir}/data/interim/permanova/distributed")
permanova_results_norm_dir <- glue("{wkdir}/data/interim/permanova/normalized_distributed")

```

Loading in metadata and KrakenUniq read profiles

```{r, eval=FALSE}
metadata_categories_df <- readRDS(
  glue(
    "{wkdir}/data/interim/metadata/",
    "2023-06-06_metadata_categories_dataframe.rds"
  )
)
metadata_categories <- readRDS(
    glue(
      "{wkdir}/data/interim/metadata/",
      "2023-06-06_metadata_categories.rds"
    )
  )

ps_trim <- readRDS(
    glue(
        "{wkdir}/data/processed/",
        "phyloseq_objects/decontaminated/",
        "2024-02-25_WGS_KrakenUnique_phyloseq.rds"
    )
)

cohorts <- meta(ps_trim)$study %>% unique()

# split the phyloseq object by study into a list
ps_by_study <- cohorts %>%
  purrr::set_names() %>%
  purrr::map(function(x) {
    filtered_sample_data <- subset(sample_data(ps_trim), study == x)
    prune_samples(sample_names(filtered_sample_data), ps_trim)
  })

```

Executing PERMANOVA on KrakenUniq read with batchtools parallelization


```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Parallelizing with slurm ---- 
batchtools_params <- expand.grid(
  metadata_column = unlist(metadata_categories,
      recursive = TRUE, use.names = FALSE
    ),
    metadata = cohorts) %>% 
  as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(
      ps_object = map(metadata, ~ ps_by_study[[.x]]),
      threads = 4,
      nperm = 10000,
      output_path = glue(
        "{permanova_results_dir}/",
        "{metadata}_{metadata_column}.tsv"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      metadata_column %nin% c("study", "participant_id"),
      !grepl("roi|ref", metadata_column)
    ) %>% 
    filter(!file.exists(output_path)) %>%
    glimpse()

# configure registry ----
cluster_run <- glue("{get_time()}_PERMANOVA")
message("\n\nRUNNING:  ", cluster_run, "\n")
breg <- makeRegistry(
  file.dir = glue(
    "{wkdir}/.cluster_runs/",
    cluster_run
  ),
  seed = 42
)
breg$cluster.functions <- batchtools::makeClusterFunctionsSlurm(
  template = glue("{wkdir}/batchtools_templates/batchtools.slurm.tmpl"),
  scheduler.latency = 0.1,
  fs.latency = 1
)
# Submit Jobs ----
jobs <- batchMap(
  fun = phyloseq_permanova_slurm,
  args = batchtools_params,
  reg = breg
)
jobs[, chunk := chunk(job.id, chunk.size = 20)]
print(jobs[, .N, by = chunk])

submitJobs(jobs,
  resources = list(
    walltime = 200,
    memory = 5000,
    ncpus = 4,
    max.concurrent.jobs = 9999
  )
)

```


Running analysis using counts normalized by human read depth and filtering taxa from each cohort that are undetected.

```{r, eval=FALSE}

wgs_flagstat_meta <- readRDS(
  glue(
    "{wkdir}/data/processed/readqc/",
    "2024-02-25_WGS_flagstat-metrics_phyloseq-formatted.rds"
  )
)
all(wgs_flagstat_meta$sample_id == rownames(meta(ps_trim)))

# adding flagstat metrics to phyloseq object
phyloseq::sample_data(ps_trim)[colnames(wgs_flagstat_meta)] <-
    wgs_flagstat_meta
mapped_human_reads <- meta(ps_trim)$flagstat_01_cram_mapped

# normalize by mapped human reads (sample IDS should be aligned)
ps_trim_norm <- ps_trim
otu_table(ps_trim_norm) %>% colSums() %>% head
otu_table(ps_trim_norm) <- otu_table(ps_trim_norm) / mapped_human_reads
otu_table(ps_trim_norm) %>% colSums() %>% head

ps_by_study_norm <- cohorts %>%
  purrr::set_names() %>%
  purrr::map(function(x) {
    filtered_sample_data <- subset(sample_data(ps_trim_norm), study == x)
    ps <- prune_samples(sample_names(filtered_sample_data), ps_trim_norm) %>%
      microbiome::core(., detection = 0, prevalence = 1e-5)
  })

saveRDS(
  ps_trim_norm,
  glue(
    "{wkdir}/data/processed/",
    "phyloseq_objects/decontaminated/",
    "{Sys.Date()}_WGS_KrakenUnique_phyloseq_humanreadnorm.rds"
  )
)

```


Permanova execution with normalized and filtered phyloseq objects using 50k permutations per metadata.

```{r, eval=FALSE}

# Parallelizing with slurm ---- 
batchtools_params <- expand.grid(
  metadata_column = unlist(metadata_categories,
      recursive = TRUE, use.names = FALSE
    ),
    metadata = cohorts) %>% 
  as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(
      ps_object = map(metadata, ~ ps_by_study_norm[[.x]]),
      threads = 2,
      nperm = 10000,
      output_path = glue(
        "{permanova_results_norm_dir}/",
        "{metadata}_{metadata_column}.tsv"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      metadata_column %nin% c("study", "participant_id"),
      !grepl("roi|ref", metadata_column)
    ) %>% 
    filter(!file.exists(output_path)) %>%
    glimpse()

# configure registry ----
cluster_run <- glue("{get_time()}_PERMANOVA_norm")
message("\n\nRUNNING:  ", cluster_run, "\n")
breg <- makeRegistry(
  file.dir = glue(
    "{wkdir}/.cluster_runs/",
    cluster_run
  ),
  seed = 42
)
breg$cluster.functions <- batchtools::makeClusterFunctionsSlurm(
  template = glue("{wkdir}/batchtools_templates/batchtools.slurm.tmpl"),
  scheduler.latency = 0.1,
  fs.latency = 1
)
# Submit Jobs ----
jobs <- batchMap(
  fun = phyloseq_permanova_slurm,
  args = batchtools_params,
  reg = breg
)
jobs[, chunk := chunk(job.id, chunk.size = 50)]
print(jobs[, .N, by = chunk])

submitJobs(jobs,
  resources = list(
    walltime = 300,
    memory = 10000,
    ncpus = 4,
    max.concurrent.jobs = 9999
  )
)


```


Aggregating output files

```{r, eval=FALSE}
permanova_df <- list.files(permanova_results_norm_dir) %>%
  purrr::set_names() %>%
  purrr::map(~ read_tsv(glue("{permanova_results_norm_dir}/{.}"))) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "filename") %>%
  glimpse()

permanova_df %>% glimpse()

permanova_df_formatted <- permanova_df %>%
  left_join(metadata_categories_df) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(R2_perc = R2 * 100) %>%
  group_by(additional_metadata) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  glimpse()

saveRDS(
  permanova_df_formatted,
  glue(
    "{wkdir}/data/interim/permanova/",
    "{Sys.Date()}_PERMANOVA_n1000_normalized.rds"
  )
)

```

Visualizing results

```{r}
#| fig-height: 12

permanova_df <- readRDS(
  glue(
    "{wkdir}/data/interim/permanova/",
    "2024-02-27_PERMANOVA_n1000_normalized.rds"
  )
)

p_perm_dist_plotly <- permanova_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = -log10(FDR), x = R2_perc, group = metadata)) +
  geom_point(aes(
  color = metadata_class, size = n), alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Explained variance R2 (%)",
    y = "-log10(FDR)",
    color = "Metadata Category",
    size = "Analysis N"
  ) +
  scale_color_npg()
ggplotly(p_perm_dist_plotly)

```


```{r, eval=FALSE}

p_perm_dist <- permanova_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = -log10(FDR), x = R2_perc)) +
  geom_point(aes(
    color = metadata_class, size = n), alpha = 0.8
    ) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    x = expression("Explained variance" ~ R^2 ~ "(%)"),
    y = expression(-log[10] ~ "(FDR)"),
    color = "Metadata Category",
    size = "Analysis N"
  ) +
  scale_color_npg()

ggsave(
  filename = glue("{wkdir}/figures/permanova/permanova_distribution.png"),
  plot = p_perm_dist,
  width = 9,
  height = 6
)

```
